t_explain.question_or_instruction: Explain the key clauses of this agreement in simple borrower-friendly language, focusing on points that relate to the user's question.
t_explain.answer:
Based on the provided document, I will explain the key clauses that relate to the user's question.

**What happens if I miss a payment?**

According to [CLAUSE 6 | pages 1–1], if any payment is 10 days late, the Lender may charge a late fee of $25. This is mentioned in the "LATE FEE" section.

**Can I pay back the loan early?**

According to [CLAUSE 3 | pages 2–2], the Borrower has the right to pay back the loan in full or make additional payments at any time without penalty. This is mentioned in the "PREPAYMENT" section.

**What happens if I default on the loan?**

According to [CLAUSE 1 | pages 2–2], if the Borrower breaches the provision related to the Security, the Lender may declare all sums due under this Agreement immediately due and payable. Additionally, if the Borrower defaults on the loan, the Lender may declare the balance of the loan and the Security immediately due and payable, as per the "ACCELERATION" clause.

**How will my payments be applied?**

According to [CLAUSE 6 | pages 1–1], all payments made by the Borrower will be applied first to any accrued interest and secondly to the principal balance.

**What are the payment instructions?**

According to [CLAUSE 6 | pages 1–1], the Borrower shall make payment to the Lender in the following instructions: All monthly payments of $313.36 shall be made by electronic transfer (ACH/online payment) to the Lender's designated bank account on or before the 8th day of each month, beginning November 8, 2025.

**What happens if I sell the Security?**

According to [CLAUSE 2 | pages 2–2], the Security may not be sold or transferred without the Lender's consent until the Due Date. If the Borrower breaches this provision, the Lender may declare all sums due under this Agreement immediately due and payable, unless prohibited by applicable law.
